verdict.rationale: Evidence only confirms a general 'self-host with Docker for free' claim, with no documented Docker Compose file specifics, Kubernetes/Helm chart, VPS deployment guide, or Raspberry Pi instructions. Community comments only discuss desktop/Docker installation issues (chrome-sandbox fix, docker pull timeout), not multi-platform official guides. Missing for 10: Kubernetes/Helm deployment guide, VPS-specific guide, Raspberry Pi guide, and a maintained Docker Compose file/documentation.
